AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .title absolute box with platform left/right clearances; .title-path flex-end overflow clip; filename flex-shrink:0; dead GH#339 rule removed.

Review.Findings: Independent agent review: 0 BLOCKER, 5 MINOR, 2 NIT for C-9.
